invariants.rationale: Keycodes are typically represented by non-negative integer constants in UI and input libraries.
If keyRepeatTask's keycode does not match, the task is rescheduled with the new keycode and becomes scheduled.
After calling scheduleKeyRepeatTask, the keyRepeatTask is always scheduled if this method is allowed to proceed.
On method exit, keyRepeatTask.keycode is set to the incoming keycode regardless of prior state.
